prompt: Use the reference image as the design reference for a square app icon. Keep what makes it work: a classic portable typewriter seen from the front, reduced to one emblem; a low wide trapezoid body in jade-green enamel with one neat row of five round ivory keys, a charcoal platen roller with two round end knobs across its top, and a fresh white sheet of paper rising straight up out of the roller, near its top a short typed line of four tiny dark dots ending in a small solid cursor block; flat shapes with a soft tonal gradient, crisp edges, one soft light from the upper left, centred with even breathing room. Full-bleed opaque 1:1 canvas, the ground runs edge to edge; no rounded corners, no border, no text, no letters except where stated. Shared fix: the sheet of paper must separate clearly from the ground, with a crisp cool-grey edge and a soft shadow where it meets the roller. Change only the degree of abstraction: make it a clearly visible cut-paper collage. Every part is a separate piece of matte coloured card cut with scissors-crisp edges: the jade body built from two stacked card layers in two greens, the roller a charcoal card strip, the keys ivory card discs, the sheet a white card; each layer casts a short soft offset shadow on the layer below, the card surfaces show a very fine paper grain, and the outer silhouette is slightly simplified with straight cut edges. Ground: pure white #FFFFFF card with fine grain.
